**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD101877

**Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

• Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on-prem, or air-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes.

• AI-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI-generated code through automated tests and review.

• Production trust and safety: prompt-injection defense, permission-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Ships. Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved.

• Treats evaluation as part of the product. Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling.

• Is fluent in both worlds. Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.

• Thinks in reusable patterns. Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?”

• Moves fast without leaving a mess. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade-off deliberately.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about understanding how offshore wind turbines respond to the forces of nature? Do you want to use your engineering expertise to influence the design, performance and long-term reliability of offshore wind farms?

At Vattenfall, we believe there is a way to build a more sustainable energy future. We're looking for a Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer to join our Structural Loads team within Offshore Engineering.

In this specialist role, you'll work at the heart of offshore wind turbine engineering, using engineering analysis, aeroelastic modelling and measurement data to investigate complex turbine behaviour and turn the results into sound engineering decisions.

From early development and turbine selection through to operational optimisation and lifetime extension, your expertise will help shape important technical decisions across our offshore wind portfolio.

You'll join an international team of engineering specialists who value collaboration, technical excellence and finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

Your Role

As a Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer, you'll combine hands-on technical expertise with responsibility for delivering complex engineering work across offshore wind projects and operating assets.

Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, turbine manufacturers and external partners, you'll help ensure our offshore wind turbines are designed and operated safely, efficiently and reliably.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Advanced engineering analysis: Independently define, perform and technically own aeroelastic load analyses, including modelling strategy, execution, validation and interpretation, turning complex results into sound engineering conclusions and decisions.

• Structural integrity: Assess wind turbine and support-structure loading and independently investigate and resolve complex engineering questions relating to fatigue, structural performance and lifetime extension.

• Project delivery: Technically lead load-related engineering activities, ensuring technical deliverables meet project requirements, quality standards and deadlines, and act as the Structural Loads technical point of contact for assigned projects.

• Technical collaboration: Work closely with specialists across Wind Turbine Engineering, Primary Structures, Geotechnical Engineering and Metocean to solve multidisciplinary engineering problems where turbine loads, structural response and environmental conditions interact.

• Stakeholder engagement: Act as a trusted technical partner to internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating complex loads-related questions, risks and results into clear engineering recommendations that support project decisions.

• Innovation and improvement: Develop and refine simulation models, engineering tools and analysis methods to improve turbine performance, reduce technical risks and support continuous improvement.

Your Profile

We're looking for an experienced engineering specialist who can independently investigate and solve complex engineering problems, translating detailed analysis into well-founded engineering conclusions and practical solutions.

You'll bring a strong understanding of wind turbine aeroelasticity and structural dynamics, alongside the ability to take technical ownership, exercise sound engineering judgement and communicate complex technical matters clearly and effectively across different disciplines.

Qualifications

• A master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Wind Energy or a closely related discipline.

• At least 7 years of relevant industry experience in wind turbine aeroelasticity, load simulation or structural dynamics.

• Extensive hands-on experience defining and performing aeroelastic load analyses, including model development, simulation, validation, post-processing and interpretation of results.

• Strong knowledge of wind turbine aerodynamics, structural dynamics, control systems and load-generation mechanisms.

• Experience interpreting simulation results, validating engineering models and working with measurement data.

• Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering environments, ideally within offshore wind, turbine manufacturing or renewable energy development.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

It would also be beneficial if you have experience in:

• Offshore wind turbine foundation design, hydrodynamics or coupled turbine-foundation analysis.

• Relevant IEC and DNV standards and certification processes.

• Engineering programming tools such as Python or MATLAB.

• Operational load assessments, turbine power upgrades or lifetime extension projects.

Above all, you'll bring curiosity, a careful and structured approach to engineering challenges, and a genuine interest in sharing knowledge and developing solutions together.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than 02/12/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with around 20,000 employees. For more than 100 years, we have powered societies and industries through innovation and collaboration. Today, we are focused on enabling a more sustainable energy system and supporting the transition to cleaner ways of living.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. In addition, we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**The Principal Value Management and Advisory Consultant at SimCorp provides expert guidance to clients on how to leverage SimCorp’s solutions to achieve strategic business outcomes. With typically 8-12 years of experience in value advisory, consulting, or a related field, this role focuses on delivering qualified and validated insights and tailored solution proposals that drive business transformation. The Principal Value Management and Advisory Consultant works closely with clients, account managers (CSMs), sales teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure that SimCorp’s solutions are positioned and implemented in a way that maximizes value, efficiency, and effectiveness.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead advisory engagements with clients, helping them define their business objectives and aligning SimCorp’s solutions to drive value.

• Provide strategic guidance on the selection, implementation, and optimization of SimCorp’s solutions to address complex client needs.

• Develop and present business cases, ROI models, and value assessments to demonstrate the impact of SimCorp’s solutions on client business performance.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, ensuring the alignment of technology solutions with business goals and strategic priorities.

• Collaborate with sales teams to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, while ensuring that solutions are tailored to client requirements.

• Provide guidance and best practices to clients during the solution implementation process, ensuring smooth adoption and maximizing value from the product.

• Conduct workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with clients and internal teams to drive understanding of SimCorp’s solutions and industry best practices.

• Continuously engage with clients to assess ongoing needs and opportunities for further optimization or expansion of SimCorp solutions.

• Work with solution architects to influence product roadmaps and bring forward client feedback.

• Mentor and support junior consultants, sharing expertise and developing their capabilities within the Value Advisory team.

**What We Value

**

• Deep knowledge of the investment management value-chain on the buy-side

• Current knowledge of industry business trends and technology trends

• Expert in management consulting practices such as defining capability map, value-mapping, strategic portfolio management

• Value selling and value consulting expertise with knowledge of ROI (return of investment modelling) and consultative selling methodologies and frameworks

• Preferably experience in sales or sales support working for one of the largest investment management solutions vendors such as SimCorp, Murex, Blackrock, or Charles River

• Work experience in management consulting in a consulting firm or formal trainings as part of the job

• Foundational understanding of data management practices

• Foundational understanding of security types

• Willingness to travel as required.

• Flexibility to attend SimCorp office 2x/week as per our hybrid policy.

**Benefits

**SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Azeta GUITI, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. This position is for an existing vacancy.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.
